hour_rule: Real time where the place holds 95 percent of the year's hours, otherwise day-ahead, said per place and year. An hour of real time is the mean of its four 15-minute prices and counts only when all four are held (free_energy.py's rule).
whole_year_rule: A year's share or total is written only when 95 percent of its hours (prices) or 90 percent of its days (curtailment) are held; else null.

curtailment.name: CAISO, the whole system
curtailment.time: Pacific clock time, as CAISO's five-minute record is
curtailment.source: California ISO, wind and solar curtailment reports (five-minute record), as the ERW's tables caiso_curtailment_intervals and caiso_curtailment_profile hold them

curtailment.name: SPP, the whole system
curtailment.source: Southwest Power Pool, wind and solar curtailment (daily), as the ERW's table spp_curtailment_daily holds it
curtailment.by_hour_reason: SPP publishes its curtailment by day, not by hour, so it has no hour of the day

curtailment_not_held.ercot: ERCOT publishes no curtailment figure; the curtailment page's ERCOT figure is the ERW's arithmetic (output against the limits ERCOT publishes) and is not drawn here

curtailment_not_held.nyiso: no curtailment figure of NYISO is held
curtailment_not_held.isone: no curtailment figure of ISO-NE is held
